terms_clauses.text: TERMS AND CONDITIONS CIMB Up to 50% OFF on Flights Campaign 1. The CIMB Up to 50% OFF on Flights Campaign (“the Campaign”) is jointly organised by CIMB Bank Berhad [Registration No: 197201001799 (13491-P)] (“CIMB Bank”) and CIMB Islamic Bank Berhad [Registration No: 200401032872 (671380-H)] (“CIMB Islamic Bank”). CIMB Bank and/or CIMB Islamic Bank shall herein collectively be referred to as “CIMB”. The Campaign Period 2. The Campaign shall run from 5 October 2026 to 31 December 2026, both dates inclusive (the “Campaign Period”). 3. CIMB reserves the right upon giving notice of not less than seven (7) calendar days to change the duration and/or the commencement and/or the expiry dates of the Campaign Period. Eligibility 4. This Campaign is open to all CIMB Preferred Visa Infinite/-i, Travel World Elite and Travel World principal credit cardholders (“Eligible Participants”). The CIMB Preferred Visa Infinite/-i, Travel World Elite and/or Travel World Credit Cards of the Eligible Participants are hereinafter referred to as the “Eligible Credit Cards”. 5. It shall be the Eligible Participants’ sole responsibility to ensure their mobile numbers (“Contact Details”) provided to CIMB are current and updated with CIMB in the event if any changes being made to the same by them. CIMB reserves the right to forfeit the Cashback in the event the Eligible Participants’ Contact Details maintained in CIMB’s record is invalid and/or not updated. CIMB shall not be responsible to the Eligible Participants for any loss (including loss of opportunity and consequential loss arising therefrom) suffered or incurred in the event the Contact Details maintained in CIMB’s record are not current or correct. Campaign Mechanics and Conditions 6. To qualify for Up to 50% OFF Flight Tickets, which will be fulfilled in the form of Cashback based on the Campaign Qualifying Criteria (“Cashback”), Eligible Participants must use their Eligible Credit Card to fulfil the “Campaign Conditions” set out in Table 1.0 below: Tier V1 Qualifying Criteria 1 (“Eligible Flight Transactions”) Qualifying Criteria 2 (CASA/-i Balance / Foreign Spend) Cashback (Fulfilled Qualifying Criteria 1 & Qualifying Criteria 2) Page 1 of 11 1 Maintain a minimum Quarterly Average Balance1 of RM250,000 in CIMB Current Account/-i and/or Savings Account/-i (“CASA/-i”) during the Campaign Period. OR Meet a minimum cumulative spend of RM60,000 on ‘Eligible Foreign Spend Transactions’ during the Campaign Period. Maintain a minimum Quarterly Average Balance1 of RM150,000 in CIMB Current Account/-i and/or Savings Account/-i (“CASA/-i”) during the Campaign Period. 2 OR Any transaction made on ‘Eligible Airlines’ with a minimum of RM1,000 per transaction 3 Meet a minimum cumulative spend of RM40,000 on ‘Eligible Foreign Spend Transactions’ during the Campaign Period. Maintain a minimum Quarterly Average Balance1 of RM100,000 in CIMB Current Account/-i and/or Savings Account/-i (“CASA/-i”) during the Campaign Period. 50% Cashback on the highest ‘Eligible Flight Transactions’ performed during the Campaign Period, capped at RM2,000. 40% Cashback on the highest ‘Eligible Flight Transactions’ performed during the Campaign Period, capped at RM1,000. 30% Cashback on the highest ‘Eligible Flight Transactions’ performed during the Campaign Period, capped at RM500. OR Meet a minimum cumulative spend of RM20,000 on ‘Eligible Foreign Spend Transactions’ during the Campaign Period. Maintain a minimum Quarterly Average Balance1 of RM50,000 in CIMB Current Account/-i and/or Savings Account/-i (“CASA/-i”) during the Campaign Period. 4 20% Cashback on the highest ‘Eligible Flight Transactions’ performed during the Campaign Period, capped at RM250. OR Meet a minimum cumulative spend of RM10,000 on ‘Eligible Foreign Spend Transactions’ during the Campaign Period. Eligible Foreign Spend Transactions will be converted to Ringgit Malaysia (RM) for tracking purposes to calculate the Quarterly Cumulative Eligible Foreign Spend, based on CIMB’s prevailing exchange rate. If the purchase amount of a Foreign Currency Transaction is converted to Ringgit Malaysia at the point of sale via Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC), it will be categorized as a Local Transaction. For clarity, a transaction will be considered as a Foreign Currency Transaction only if the currency code of the transaction is in any foreign currency excluding Ringgit Malaysia (RM). 7. Cashback will be awarded to Eligible Participants who meet the Qualifying Criteria stated in Table 1.0 of Clause 6, in accordance with the allocation and ranking method stated in the below table. Once the Cashback pool has been fully taken up, an Eligible Participant will not be entitled to the Cashback even if the Eligible Participant fulfils the Qualifying Criteria and Campaign Conditions. Kempen ini sah dari 1 November 2026 hingga 30 Jun 2027, termasuk kedua-dua tarikh (“Tempoh Kempen”). Kelayakan

Kempen ini terbuka secara eksklusif kepada semua Ahli Kad Komersial/Kad Perniagaan PB Visa Baharu (di bawah akaun syarikat baharu) yang diluluskan dari 1 November 2026 sehingga akhir Tempoh Kempen (“Ahli Kad yang Layak”). Ahli Kad yang Layak akan layak untuk Pulangan Tunai tambahan 1% untuk semua urus niaga sebagai tambahan kepada ciri-ciri sedia ada kad tanpa memerlukan perbelanjaan minimum apabila mereka berbelanja menggunakan Kad Komersial PB Visa/Kad Perniagaan PB Visa baharu. Nota:a. “Urus niaga yang Layak” hendaklah termasuk pembelian dalam dan luar negara bagi apa-apa barang atau perniagaan menggunakan Kad Komersial PB Visa dan Kad Perniagaan PB Visa. b. “Urus niaga yang Layak” tidak termasuk urus niaga yang dibuat oleh Ahli Kad dengan mana-mana saudagar yang berkaitan atau dikawal oleh mereka (sama ada sebagai pekerja, majikan, pemegang saham atau pengarah) misalnya urus niaga oleh Ahli Kad dengan mana-mana perbadanan atau entiti perniagaan yang beliau merupakan pekerja, majikan atau bekerja dengannya atau mempunyai saham atau kepentingan di dalamnya atau merupakan pengarah.
Urus niaga yang Layak akan dikesan berdasarkan tarikh urus niaga.

Pulangan Tunai dihadkan kepada RM300 setiap Ahli Kad yang Layak setiap bulan atas dasar siapa cepat, dia dapat. Ahli Kad yang Layak akan layak untuk Pulangan Tunai setiap bulan sehingga akhir Tempoh Kempen.

terms_clauses.text: Terms & Conditions “Buy 1 Get 1 Air Ticket with PB Mastercard Credit Card” Campaign PB Campaign for Credit Cardmembers Campaign Period
The “Buy 1 Get 1 Air Ticket with PB Mastercard Credit Card” Campaign is valid from 24 August to 23 November 2026 (the “Campaign Period”). Eligibility

This Campaign is open to all Public Bank (“PB”) and Public Islamic Bank (“PIB”) Principal Mastercard Credit Cardmembers (hereinafter referred to as “Eligible Cardmember”) during the Campaign Period including employees of the Public Bank Group, Public Bank subsidiaries, Public Bank’s advertising agencies and their immediate families. Campaign Mechanic A) Buy 1 Get 1 Economy Class Air Ticket 3. Each Eligible Cardmember is entitled to ONE (1) Complimentary Companion Economy Class Return Ticket on Malaysia Airlines to selected China destinations including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Xiamen, Chengdu, Shenzhen, Changsha and Hong Kong ("Complimentary Companion Ticket"). 4. The Eligible Cardmember must spend his credit card for a minimum accumulative of RM20,000 within 30 calendar days on and/or before each purchase of flight ticket for Qualifying Retail Transactions in any one participating month during Campaign Period to qualify for the Complimentary Companion Ticket. 5. The Eligible Cardmember must purchase ONE (1) full fare ticket to be entitled for ONE (1) Complimentary Companion Ticket. The Complimentary Companion Ticket is applicable to the base airfare only, capped at a maximum value of RM2,000 per redemption. All applicable taxes, airport charges, fuel surcharges, fees and other surcharges relating to the Complimentary Companion Ticket shall be borne by the Eligible Cardmember and must be paid using a PB/PIB Mastercard Credit Card. 6. Only ONE (1) Complimentary Companion Ticket can be earned during the Campaign Period for each Eligible Cardmember. 7. The Eligible Cardmember purchasing the companion ticket must be ONE (1) of the passengers, with ONE (1) of the ticket booked having the Eligible Cardmembers’ name. 8. The Eligible Cardmember and companion using the Complimentary Companion Ticket must be booked on the same flight and travel together. 1

The Campaign offer cannot be combined with, used in conjunction with, or exchanged for any other promotion, discount, voucher, preferential fare, special fare or promotional offer, including but not limited to fares offered during travel fairs (e.g. MATTA Fair), Malaysia Airlines Enrich Member fares, airline promotional fares, or offers provided through other banks, partners, agents or third parties.
The Campaign entitlement cannot be transferred, assigned, sold, exchanged or otherwise utilised by any other person, and non-redeemable for cash or any other monetary value.

The Campaign is subject to flight availability and applicable booking conditions. The Bank and the designated travel agent do not guarantee availability of any particular flight, travel date or destination.

“Qualified Retail Transactions” shall include all local/overseas retail spending, online purchases and new Zero Interest/Profit Instalment Plan (ZIIP/ZPIP) full purchase amount (not monthly instalment), e-wallet top up and excludes flexipay instalment amount, balance transfer, auto-debit, recurring payments, payments for utilities, direct marketing, insurance premium, government related payments, payment via www.pbebank.com, MyPB App, ATM, any refund, disputed, unauthorized or fraudulent retail transactions, cash advance/cash withdrawal, quasi cash, casino transaction, interest payments, late payment fees, finance charges, effective profit rate, annual fees, reversals, payment to charity(ies) and any form of service/miscellaneous fees.

“Qualified Retail Transactions” shall exclude transactions that the Bank may deem as non-retail transactions, including but not limited to transactions made by the Cardmember for business, commercial or resale purposes, purchases made in bulk and transactions made with any merchant associated or controlled by them (whether as an employee, employer, shareholder or director) e.g. transactions by Cardmember with any corporation or business entity in which he is an employee or employer or works with or has shares or interest in or is a director of. Exclude transactions that the Bank may deem as act or practice of deliberately misleading, hiding truth, or using artifice to gain advantage, involves dishonest behaviour, fraud, or tricks.
Split Qualified Retail Transactions up to EIGHT (8) times only per month from the same merchant are allowed to qualify for this campaign. As such, transactions above
times, shall be disqualified from the campaign.
Qualified Retail Transactions made by a Supplementary Cardmember(s) shall be aggregated with the Eligible Cardmember’s account and will be considered as Principal Cardmember’s Qualified Spend.
The tracking of Qualified Retail Transactions shall be based on transaction dates. 2

The total allocation of Complimentary Companion Tickets for each participating month during the Campaign Period is as follows:- Participating Months Participating Months Dates Maximum Complimentary Companion Tickets Total Complimentary Companion Tickets Allocation (RM) Month 1 24 August - 23 September 2026 100 200,000 Month 2 24 September - 23 October 2026 100 200,000 Month 3 24 October - 23 November 2026 100 200,000 300 600,000 Total
The Complimentary Companion Tickets will be allocated on a first-confirmed-andpaid, first-served basis, subject to the availability of the monthly redemption quota.
Successful validation of the Eligible Cardmember's qualifying spend does not constitute a confirmed Campaign redemption or guarantee the allocation of a Complimentary Companion Ticket.

The monthly redemption allocation will only be considered confirmed upon successful spend validation, confirmation of the flight booking by the Eligible Cardmember and receipt of full payment for the booking.

The Campaign will end upon the earlier occurrence of either (i) the expiry of the Campaign Period, or (ii) full utilisation of the total Complimentary Companion Tickets allocation of RM600,000, whichever occurs first. Once the Campaign has ended, no further redemptions or Campaign entitlements will be accepted or honoured, notwithstanding that the stated Campaign Period has not yet expired.

The Complimentary Companion Tickets will be earned by the Eligible Cardmember shall be tracked based on the example of scenarios in the following manner:Flight Ticket Purchase Date Spending Details Entitlement for Complimentary Companion Tickets 24 August 2026 Eligible Cardmember spend RM20,000 on 24 August 2026 Yes 24 August 2026 Eligible Cardmember spend RM18,000 on 24 August 2026 No 3 24 August 2026 Eligible Cardmember spend RM20,000 on 25 September 2026 No 1 October 2026 Eligible Cardmember spend the following: RM15,000 on 2 September 2026 RM5,300 on 1 October 2026 Yes 1 October 2026 Eligible Cardmember spend the following: RM10,000 on 2 September 2026 RM9,800 on 1 October 2026 No 1 October 2026 Eligible Cardmember spend the following: RM15,000 on 1 October 2026 RM5,300 on 30 October 2026 No 1 October 2026 Eligible Cardmember spend the following: RM12,000 on 1 September 2026 RM9,000 on 1 October 2026 No Bookings and Reservation Information:

Eligible Cardmembers shall contact the Bank’s designated travel agent via the designated booking channels to enquire about the Campaign and provide the required Bank card information for initial eligibility screening. • Designated Travel Agent: Holiday Tours & Travel Sdn Bhd • Booking Channels: - Email: hi@holidaytours.com.my - Hotline: 603-2303 1500 - WhatsApp: +6012 926 2971 (text only) • Operating Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am – 5pm
The designated travel agent will perform an initial screening based on the eligible card information provided and submit the Eligible Cardmember's details to the Bank for qualifying spend validation.
The Bank will validate the Eligible Cardmember's qualifying spend and provide to the designated travel agent, the qualifying amount made by Cardmember as at the date the enquiry is made. 4

Successful spend validation does not constitute a confirmed redemption or guarantee the complimentary ticket. The monthly redemption quota will only be secured when:• Qualifying spend has been successfully validated; • The Eligible Cardmember has confirmed the booking; and • Full payment required for the booking has been charged to the same Eligible Principal PB/PIB Mastercard Credit Card.
The Campaign's monthly redemption quota shall be allocated on a first-confirmedand-paid, first-served basis, subject to the availability of the monthly quota.
Eligible Cardmember can proceed with the booking upon confirmation of eligibility by the Bank.
Reservations must be made at least SEVEN (7) working days prior to the departure date, with travel period up to ELEVEN (11) months from the booking date.

Ticket must be issued as a return flight originating from any Malaysian airport to one of the eligible destinations listed below, with a maximum of ONE (1) domestic stopover permitted within Malaysia; open-jaw and multi-city itineraries are not allowed. • Beijing Daxing International Airport (PKX) • Shanghai Pudong International Airport (PVG) • Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport (CAN) • Xiamen Gaoqi International Airport (XMN) • Chengdu Tianfu International Airport (TFU) • Shenzhen Baoan International Airport (SZX) • Changsha Huanghua International Airport (CSX) • Hong Kong International Airport (HKG)

The Campaign is applicable to Malaysia Airlines-operated flights only, subject to the airline’s applicable fare rules, conditions of carriage, ticketing conditions and seat availability, unless otherwise stated in these Terms & Conditions.
All rates and availability for the offer are provided by the Bank’s designated travel agent and subject to Holiday Tours & Travel Terms and Conditions. Changes and Cancellations:
All tickets issued under this Campaign are strictly non-transferable and nonrefundable. No refunds will be issued for cancellations or missed flights.

Trip changes are allowed, whereby any changes to the booking after confirmation shall be subject to the applicable airline fare rules, availability, fare differences, airline charges and the designated travel agent’s applicable service fees at the Eligible Cardmember's expenses. 5

Any changes affecting either the paid ticket or complimentary ticket may result in the complimentary ticket being forfeited, subject to the applicable fare rules and Campaign conditions. Other Terms & Conditions

The Bank reserves the right to charge the full cost of the Complimentary Companion Ticket to the Eligible Cardmember’s account if the Eligible Cardmember is found to have redeemed the Complimentary Companion Ticket while meeting the qualifying spend requirement through subsequently cancelled, refunded, disputed, unauthorized, fraudulent and/or non-retail transactions.

The Bank reserves the right to reject any redemption where the Eligible Cardmember is found to have provided inaccurate information, failed to meet the qualifying spend requirement, or otherwise failed to comply with these Terms & Conditions.
The Bank reserves the right to disqualify any transaction subsequently determined to be reversed, refunded, disputed, fraudulent, unauthorised or otherwise ineligible for qualifying spend.
In the event of any dispute relating to the qualifying spend, the Bank's determination shall be final and conclusive.
The Bank and the designated travel agent shall not be responsible for any delays, cancellations, schedule changes or disruptions caused by the airline or circumstances beyond its reasonable control.
The Bank reserves the right to amend, suspend or terminate the Campaign where reasonably necessary, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

By participating in the Campaign, the Eligible Cardmember agrees to be bound by these Terms & Conditions and the applicable terms and conditions of the Bank, the designated travel agent and Malaysia Airlines. For more details, please refer to https://www.pbebank.com/en/promotions/latest-promotions/pb-mastercardprivileges-alipay/ 6 C) Trip.com • Up to 10% Off on China Hotels • Promo code: PBCHINA10 Booking Period: Now till 31 December 2026 For more Terms and Conditions apply. In the event of any inconsistency between these Terms and Conditions and the said Agreement, these Terms and Conditions shall prevail in so far as they apply to the “Buy 1 Get 1 Air Ticket with PB Mastercard Credit Card” Campaign. 5. In the event of a conflict, discrepancy or variance in the terms and conditions in the English Language version and Bahasa Malaysia version, the terms and conditions of the English Language version shall prevail. 7 Terma dan Syarat Kempen “Beli 1 Dapatkan 1 Tiket Penerbangan dengan Kad Kredit PB Mastercard” Kempen PB untuk Ahli Kad Kredit Tempoh Kempen
Kempen “Beli 1 Dapatkan 1 Tiket Penerbangan dengan Kad Kredit PB Mastercard” sah dari 24 Ogos hingga 23 November 2026 (“Tempoh Kempen”). Kelayakan

Kempen ini terbuka kepada semua Ahli Kad Kredit Utama Mastercard Public Bank (“PB”) dan Public Islamic Bank (“PIB”) (selepas ini dirujuk sebagai “Ahli Kad yang Layak”) semasa Tempoh Kempen termasuk kakitangan Kumpulan Public Bank, subsidiari Public Bank, agensi pengiklanan Public Bank dan ahli keluarga terdekat masing-masing. Mekanisme Kempen A) Beli 1 Dapatkan 1 Tiket Penerbangan Kelas Ekonomi 3. Setiap Ahli Kad yang Layak layak menerima SATU (1) Komplimentari Tiket Penerbangan Pergi Balik Kelas Ekonomi untuk Pengiring daripada Malaysia Airlines ke destinasi China yang terpilih termasuk Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Xiamen, Chengdu, Shenzhen, Changsha dan Hong Kong ("Tiket Pengiring Komplimentari"). 4. Ahli Kad yang Layak mesti membelanjakan kad kreditnya untuk amaun terkumpul minimum sebanyak RM20,000 dalam tempoh 30 hari kalendar pada dan/atau sebelum setiap pembelian tiket penerbangan untuk Urus niaga Runcit yang Layak dalam mana-mana satu bulan penyertaan semasa Tempoh Kempen, untuk layak menerima Tiket Pengiring Komplimentari. 5. Ahli Kad yang Layak mesti membeli SATU (1) tiket tambang penuh untuk layak menerima SATU (1) Tiket Pengiring Komplimetari. Tiket Pengiring Komplimentari tersebut diterima pakai kepada tambang penerbangan asas sahaja, dihadkan kepada nilai maksimum RM2,000 bagi setiap penebusan. Semua cukai, caj lapangan terbang, surcaj bahan api, fi dan surcaj lain yang dikenakan berkaitan dengan Tiket Pengiring Komplimentari hendaklah ditanggung oleh Ahli Kad yang Layak dan mesti dibayar menggunakan Kad Kredit PB/PIB Mastercard. 6. Hanya SATU (1) Tiket Pengiring Komplimentari boleh diperoleh semasa Tempoh Kempen untuk setiap Ahli Kad yang Layak. 7. Ahli Kad yang Layak yang membeli tiket pengiring mestilah salah SEORANG (1) penumpang, dengan SATU (1) tiket yang ditempah di bawah nama Ahli Kad yang Layak. 8 8. Ahli Kad yang Layak dan pengiring yang menggunakan Tiket Pengiring Komplimentari mestilah menempah penerbangan yang sama dan menaiki penerbangan tersebut bersama-sama. 9. Tawaran ini tidak boleh digabungkan, digunakan bersama-sama dengan atau ditukar untuk mana-mana promosi, diskaun, baucar, tambang keutamaan, tambang istimewa atau tawaran promosi lain, termasuk tetapi tidak terhad kepada tambang yang ditawarkan semasa karnival pelancongan (misalnya Karnival MATTA), tambang Ahli Enrich Malaysia Airlines, tambang promosi syarikat penerbangan atau tawaran yang disediakan melalui bank lain, rakan niaga, ejen atau pihak ketiga.
Kelayakan Kempen tidak boleh dipindah milik, diserah hak, dijual, ditukar atau sebaliknya digunakan oleh mana-mana orang lain dan tidak boleh ditebus untuk tunai atau apa-apa nilai wang lain.

Kempen ini tertakluk pada ketersediaan penerbangan dan syarat tempahan yang diterima pakai. Bank dan ejen pelancongan yang ditetapkan tidak menjamin ketersediaan mana-mana penerbangan, tarikh pelancongan atau destinasi tertentu.

“Urus niaga Runcit yang Layak” termasuk semua perbelanjaan runcit dalam negeri/luar negeri, pembelian dalam talian dan amaun pembelian penuh Pelan Ansuran Faedah/Keuntungan Sifar (ZIIP/ZPIP) (bukan ansuran bulanan), tambah nilai e-dompet dan tidak termasuk amaun ansuran flexipay, pindahan baki, debit auto, bayaran berulang, bayaran untuk utiliti, pemasaran terus, premium insurans, bayaran berkaitan kerajaan, bayaran melalui www.pbebank.com, MyPB App, ATM, apa-apa urus niaga runcit yang dipulangkan balik, dipertikai, tanpa kebenaran atau berunsur penipuan, pendahuluan tunai/pengeluaran tunai, tunai sebahagian, urus niaga kasino, bayaran faedah, fi bayaran lewat, caj kewangan, kadar keuntungan efektif, fi tahunan, penarikan balik, bayaran kepada badan kebajikan dan apa-apa bentuk fi perkhidmatan dan/atau rencam.

“Urus niaga Runcit yang Layak” tidak termasuk urus niaga yang Bank anggap sebagai urus niaga bukan runcit, termasuk tetapi tidak terhad kepada urus niaga yang dibuat oleh Ahli Kad bagi tujuan perniagaan, komersial atau penjualan semula, pembelian secara pukal serta urus niaga yang dibuat dengan mana-mana saudagar yang berkaitan atau dikawal oleh mereka (sama ada sebagai pekerja, majikan, pemegang saham atau pengarah) misalnya urus niaga oleh Ahli Kad dengan manamana perbadanan atau entiti perniagaan yang beliau merupakan pekerja, majikan atau bekerja dengannya atau mempunyai saham atau kepentingan di dalamnya atau merupakan pengarah. Tidak termasuk urus niaga yang Bank mungkin anggap sebagai tindakan atau amalan yang disengajakan untuk mengelirukan, menyembunyikan kebenaran atau menggunakan muslihat untuk memperoleh manfaat, melibatkan perlakuan tidak jujur, penipuan atau helah. 9

Pembahagian Urus niaga Runcit yang Layak sehingga LAPAN (8) kali sebulan sahaja daripada saudagar yang sama dibenarkan untuk layak untuk kempen ini. Justeru, urus niaga melebihi 8 kali akan hilang kelayakan daripada kempen.
Urus niaga Runcit yang Layak yang dibuat oleh Ahli Kad Tambahan akan digabungkan dengan akaun Urus niaga Ahli Kad yang Layak dan akan dianggap sebagai Perbelanjaan yang Layak oleh Ahli Kad Utama.
Pengesanan Urus niaga Runcit yang Layak adalah berdasarkan tarikh urus niaga.

Jumlah peruntukan untuk Tiket Pengiring Komplimentari bagi setiap bulan penyertaan semasa Tempoh Kempen adalah seperti yang berikut:Bulan Penyertaan Tarikh Bulan Penyertaan Bulan 1 24 Ogos - 23 September 2026 100 Jumlah Peruntukan Tiket Pengiring Komplimentari (RM) 200,000 Bulan 2 24 September - 23 Oktober 2026 100 200,000 Bulan 3 24 Oktober - 23 November 2026 100 200,000 300 600,000 Jumlah Tiket Pengiring Komplimentari Maksimum
Tiket Pengiring Komplimentari akan diperuntukkan atas dasar pengesahan dan pembayaran terawal, tertakluk pada ketersediaan kuota penebusan bulanan.
Perbelanjaan yang layak oleh Ahli Kad yang Layak yang berjaya disahkan bukanlah merupakan pengesahan bagi penebusan Kempen atau jaminan bagi peruntukan Tiket Pengiring Komplimentari.
Peruntukan penebusan bulanan hanya akan dianggap sah selepas pengesahan perbelanjaan berjaya dibuat, pengesahan tempahan tiket oleh Ahli Kad yang layak dan bayaran penuh bagi tempahan telah diterima.

terms_clauses.text: PB & PIB Credit Card Acquisition Campaign 2026 (“Campaign”) Terms and Conditions Campaign Period 1. The Campaign is valid from now until 31 December 2026 (“Campaign Period”). Eligibility 2. The Campaign is open exclusively to New-To-Bank Public Bank Credit Card/Public Islamic Bank Credit Card-i (“Eligible Credit Card/-i”) Principal Cardmembers during the Campaign Period (“Eligible Cardmember”). 3. The following categories of Cardmembers are excluded from participating in this Campaign: 3.1. Existing PB Credit Card/PIB Credit Card-i Principal Cardmembers; 3.2. Former PB Credit Card/PIB Credit Card-i Principal Cardmembers who have cancelled his/her PB Credit Card/PIB Credit Card-i within two (2) years from the date of current application; 3.3. Employees of the Public Bank Group, its advertising agencies, their immediate families or any other persons connected with the administration of the Campaign; 3.4. Any PB Credit Card/PIB Credit Card-i Cardmembers applied via Direct Sales or RinggitPlus channel. 4. Eligible Cardmember who applied for any Eligible Credit Card/-i via this “PB & PIB Credit Card Acquisition Campaign 2026” Campaign will not be eligible for other PB Credit Card/PIB Credit Card-i Acquisition Offers. 5. Eligible Cardmember without income documents who opt to participate in the Campaign requires minimum Fixed Deposit/Term Deposit-i pledged at RM10,000 with one (1) year tenure. 1 Participation Criteria 6. To participate in this Campaign, Eligible Cardmembers are required to perform ONE (1) time online registration via PBe OR via Short Message Service (SMS) during the Campaign Period as per registration process set out below: 6.1. Register online via PBe using Key Word: PBMU or PBGM OR 6.2. Send SMS by following the example given: Key in “PBMU” or “PBGM” and send to 68333 For the avoidance of doubt, any registration using Supplementary Credit Cardmembers’ mobile phone number shall not be accepted and shall be voided. 7. Eligible Cardmember must register his/her participation for the Campaign using the mobile phone number that is registered with the Bank. In the event the mobile phone number or information provided by the Eligible Cardmember during the registration process does not match with Public Bank database, Public Bank reserves the right to reject the said registration. 8. If an Eligible Cardmember holds multiple Eligible Credit Card/-i, he/she is required to register only once and thereafter, the amount charged on all other Eligible Credit Card/-i shall be automatically tracked for the purpose of tabulating the Qualifying Transactions. 9. The Eligible Cardmember is responsible to ensure that the registration details are complete, accurate and sent during the Campaign Period. Proof of SMS sent does not constitute a confirmation of receipt by the Bank. 10. The Eligible Cardmember who successfully registers for the Campaign will receive an acknowledgement of registration (applicable for online registration only) or an SMS confirmation from the Bank (applicable for registration via SMS only). A standard normal Telecommunication Operator charges apply for each SMS registration and shall be fully borne by the Eligible Cardmember. 2 11. The Bank reserves the absolute discretion to disqualify any registration due to duplicate entries, incomplete/inaccurate details, late entries, error message, unsuccessful registration due to network failure and/or interruption experienced by a Telecommunication Operator or for any reason whatsoever as the Bank may in its absolute discretion deem fit. 12. In the event the SMS is incomplete/invalid, an outgoing SMS will be sent to the Eligible Cardmember at no cost, to inform him/her to re-register via SMS. 13. If the date and time of a successful online registration via PBe/SMS registration or transaction date and time captured in the Bank’s system differs or a dispute arises as to when the registration took place, the Bank’s system date and time shall prevail. 14. After the successful online registration via PBe/SMS registration, the Eligible Cardmember is required to use his/her Eligible Credit Card/-i in the following manner to qualify for the reward(s) under this Campaign: Reward Item Activation Gift RM25 Cash Back per Card Criteria
Apply the Eligible Credit Card/-i

Activate the Eligible Credit Card/-i and perform one (1) retail transaction Option 1 at any amount within 60 days from 4-in-1 Barry Smith card approval date (“Qualifying Luggage Set Period”) to be eligible for Activation (“Campaign Item”) Gift Key Word: PBMU
Perform one (1) time online registration via PBe OR via Short Message Service (SMS)* Welcome Gift Option 2 RM300 Cash Back (“Cash Back”)

Spend a minimum accumulative retail transactions of RM1,000 within 60 days from card approval date Key Word: PBGM (“Qualifying Period”) to be eligible for ONE (1) unit Welcome Gift *Online registration via PBe/SMS registration is required within the Qualifying Period to be eligible for Welcome Gift. 3 15. RM25 Cash Back per Card (“Activation Gift”)
Eligible Cardmember who activated their Eligible Credit Card/-i AND perform one (1) retail transaction at any amount within the Qualifying Period will be eligible for Activation Gift.

The Activation Gift will be credited to Eligible Cardmember’s Eligible Credit Card/-i account within FOUR (4) to TWELVE (12) weeks after the end of the Qualifying Period and upon fulfilment of all Terms and Conditions listed.
Each Eligible Cardmember is entitled to ONE (1) Activation Gift per Eligible Credit Card/-i account throughout the Campaign Period. 16. Welcome Gift

Eligible Cardmember who spends a minimum accumulative retail transactions of RM1,000 AND perform one-time online registration via PBe/SMS registration within the Qualifying Period will be eligible for Welcome Gift.
Each Eligible Cardmember is only entitled to ONE (1) unit Welcome Gift throughout the Campaign Period regardless of the number of Eligible Credit Card(s)/-i applied for.
The selection of Welcome Gift shall be finalized based on registered Key Word by Eligible Cardmember.

Option 1: 4-in-1 Barry Smith Luggage Set (“Campaign Item”) 16.4.1. The Campaign Item will be delivered on a first-come, firstserved basis, while stocks last. 16.4.2. The Campaign Item and/or the colour of the Campaign Item are subject to availability. In the event of unforeseen circumstance, Public Bank reserves the right to substitute alternative item of equivalent or greater value. 4 16.4.3. The Campaign Item does not include any accessory and items shown in any advertisement and/or promotional material are for illustration purposes only. 16.4.4. The Campaign Item will be delivered to the Eligible Cardmember’s mailing address in Malaysia within FOUR (4) to TWELVE (12) weeks after the end of the Qualifying Period and upon fulfilment of all Terms and Conditions listed. 16.4.5. The Bank will not entertain any request to deliver the Campaign Item to an overseas address, a third party and/or Post Office Box address. 16.4.6. The fulfilment and delivery of the Campaign Item are handled by JCMS ProRewards Sdn Bhd (Company No. 556838-A) with its registered address at 19, Jalan 51/203A, Seksyen 51, Kawasan Perindustrian Tiong Nam, 46050 Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia. 16.4.7. The contact and delivery details of the Eligible Cardmember as shared with JCMS ProRewards Sdn Bhd will be used for the purpose of fulfilment and delivering of the Campaign Item. 16.4.8. JCMS ProRewards Sdn Bhd will contact the Eligible Cardmember to verify the Eligible Cardmember's address for the purpose of delivering the Campaign Item, only when necessary. The Eligible Cardmember is to contact JCMS ProRewards Sdn Bhd at 03 – 7890 3616 or 03 – 7890 3213 on any queries pertaining to the delivery of the Campaign Item. 16.4.9. The Bank does not warrant nor liable for any damage or bodily injury occasioned by the use of the Campaign Item and neither represent the quality or fitness for any purpose of the Campaign Item.

The Bank's makes no representation or warranty to the quality, merchantability or suitability for use of the Campaign Item and accordingly the Bank shall not be responsible to replace any lost, stolen or defective Campaign Item due to defects in material or workmanship by manufacturer under warranty or 5 otherwise. The Eligible Cardmember is to liaise/contact the manufacturer directly and/or its authorised dealer for such warranty information, claim and/or Terms and Conditions specific to the installation, specification, usage and/or operation of the Campaign Item.

Any risk of loss or damage to the Campaign Item will be passed to the Eligible Cardmember after delivery of the Campaign Item. The Bank shall not be liable to recognise or replace any defective, lost, damaged or stolen after the delivery of the Campaign Item.
Option 2: RM300 Cash Back (“Cash Back”) 16.5.1. The Cash Back will be credited to Eligible Cardmember’s Eligible Credit Card/-i account within FOUR (4) to TWELVE

weeks after the end of the Qualifying Period and upon fulfilment of all Terms and Conditions listed. 17. The Activation Gift and Welcome Gift is not transferable, non-negotiable and non-exchangeable for other gift, cash, credit or in kind. 18. If there is any dispute or non-receipt of the Activation Gift and Welcome Gift, the Eligible Cardmember is required to contact PB Card Customer Service (032170 8000) by 31 March 2027 at the latest to request an inquiry. No request for any inquiry will be entertained after 31 March 2027. 19. For the purpose of this Campaign, “retail transaction” means the purchase of any goods or services (local and overseas) with the use of the Eligible Credit Card/i and may, at Public Bank’s discretion, include any Eligible Credit Card/-i and transaction as may be determined by Public Bank except for the following transactions but not limited to: a) “Flexipay” and “Zero Interest Instalment Plan/Zero Profit Instalment Plan” monthly instalment payment b) Balance Transfer c) Auto-Debit and Recurring Payments 6 d) Payments for utilities, direct marketing, insurance premiums, government related payments or payment via www.pbebank.com, MyPB App and ATM e) Any refund, disputed, unauthorized or fraudulent retail transaction f) Cash Advance/Cash Withdrawal, quasi cash, forex transactions, casino transactions, interest payments, late payment fees, finance charges/effective profit rate, annual fees, reversals, payment to charity(ies) and any other form of service/miscellaneous fees 20. “Retail transactions” shall exclude transactions that the Bank may deem as nonretail transactions, including but not limited to transactions made by the Eligible Cardmember for business, commercial or resale purposes, purchases made in bulk and transactions made with any merchant associated or controlled by them (whether as an employee, employer, shareholder or director) e.g. transactions by Eligible Cardmember with any corporation or business entity in which he/she is an employee or employer or works with or has shares or interest in or is a director of. Exclude transactions that the Bank may deem as act or practice of deliberately misleading, hiding truth, or using artifice to gain advantage, involves dishonest behaviour, fraud, or tricks. 21. An Eligible Cardmember whose card account(s) has been suspended, cancelled or terminated during the Campaign Period will not be entitled to the Activation Gift and Welcome Gift. 22. The Bank’s records of the application received and approval dates will be final and conclusive. General Terms and Conditions 23. The Bank reserves the right to change, amend, delete or add on to these Terms and Conditions from time to time with at least twenty-one (21) calendar days prior notice which notice of such change, amendment, deletion or addition shall be published on the Bank's official website. 24. By participating in this Campaign, the Eligible Cardmember: a) shall be deemed to have read, understood and agreed to be bound by these Terms and Conditions stated herein. The decision of the Bank shall be 7 final, binding and conclusive. No correspondence, disputes and appeals will be entertained; b) agrees and consents that information regarding him/her can be processed, collected, used and stored by the Bank for the purpose of this Campaign; c) agrees and consents that his/her full name, contact number and mailing address will be forwarded by the Bank to JCMS ProRewards Sdn Bhd to enable JCMS ProRewards Sdn Bhd to deliver the Welcome Gift; and d) agrees and consents that the Bank, as the case may be, may use his/her registered contact number for marketing purposes within the Bank. 25. The Bank reserves the right to cancel, terminate or suspend the Campaign. For the avoidance of doubt, cancellation, termination or suspension by the Bank of the Campaign shall not entitle the Eligible Cardmember to any claim or compensation against the Bank for any and all loss or damage suffered or incurred by the Eligible Cardmember as a direct and indirect result of the act of cancellation, termination or suspension. 26. The Bank shall not be liable, whether direct or consequential, for any loss and damage or whatsoever suffered by the Eligible Cardmember caused directly or indirectly, in whole or in part, from his/her participation in the Campaign as a result of any act or omission on the part of the Bank. 27. The Terms and Conditions herein are in addition to and without prejudice to the Terms and Conditions stated in the Cardmember Agreement applicable to the Eligible Cardmember’s Card Account. In the event of any inconsistency between these Terms and Conditions and the said Agreement, these Terms and Conditions shall prevail in so far as they apply to the “PB & PIB Credit Card Acquisition Campaign 2026”. 28. In the event of a conflict, discrepancy or variance in the Terms and Conditions in the English Language version and Bahasa Malaysia version, the Terms and Conditions of the English Language version shall prevail. _________________________________END________________________________ 8 Kempen Pemerolehan Kad Kredit PB & PIB 2026 (“Kempen”) Terma dan Syarat Tempoh Kempen 1. Kempen ini sah dari sekarang hingga 31 Disember 2026 (“Tempoh Kempen”). Kelayakan 2. Kempen ini terbuka secara eksklusif kepada Ahli Kad Kredit Utama Public Bank/Kad Kredit-i Utama Public Islamic Bank (“Kad Kredit/-i yang Layak”) Baharu semasa Tempoh Kempen (“Ahli Kad yang Layak”). 3. Kategori Ahli Kad berikut dikecualikan daripada mengambil bahagian dalam Kempen ini: 3.1. Ahli Kad Utama Kad Kredit PB/Kad Kredit-i PIB yang sedia ada; 3.2. Bekas Ahli Kad Utama Kad Kredit PB/Kad Kredit-i PIB yang telah membatalkan Kad Kredit PB/Kad Kredit-i PIB mereka dalam tempoh dua

tahun dari tarikh permohonan sekarang; 3.3. Kakitangan Kumpulan Public Bank, agensi pengiklanannya, ahli keluarga terdekat atau mana-mana orang yang mempunyai hubungan dengan pengurusan Kempen ini; 3.4. Mana-mana Ahli Kad Kredit PB/Kad Kredit-i PIB yang memohon melalui Jualan Langsung atau saluran RinggitPlus. 4. Ahli Kad yang Layak yang memohon Kad Kredit/-i yang Layak melalui “Kempen Pemerolehan Kad Kredit PB & PIB 2026” ini tidak layak untuk Tawaran Pemerolehan Kad Kredit PB/Kad Kredit-i PIB yang lain. 5. Ahli Kad yang Layak tanpa dokumen pendapatan yang memilih untuk mengambil bahagian dalam Kempen ini memerlukan Deposit Tetap/Deposit Bertempoh-i minimum yang dicagarkan sebanyak RM10,000 untuk tempoh satu

tahun. 9 Kriteria Penyertaan 6. Untuk mengambil bahagian dalam Kempen ini, Ahli Kad yang Layak dikehendaki mendaftarkan penyertaannya SATU (1) kali dalam talian melalui PBe ATAU melalui Khidmat Pesanan Ringkas (SMS) semasa Tempoh Kempen seperti proses pendaftaran yang ditetapkan di bawah: 6.1. Mendaftar dalam talian melalui PBe menggunakan Kata Kunci: PBMU atau PBGM ATAU 6.2. Menghantar SMS dengan mengikuti contoh yang diberikan: Taip “PBMU” atau “PBGM” dan hantar ke 68333 Bagi mengelakkan keraguan, apa-apa pendaftaran menggunakan nombor telefon mudah alih Ahli Kad Kredit Tambahan tidak akan diterima dan adalah terbatal. 7. Ahli Kad yang Layak dikehendaki mendaftar penyertaannya untuk Kempen ini menggunakan nombor telefon mudah alih yang didaftarkan dengan Bank. Sekiranya nombor telefon mudah alih atau maklumat yang diberikan oleh Ahli Kad yang Layak semasa proses pendaftaran tidak sama dengan data dalam rekod Public Bank, Public Bank berhak untuk menolak pendaftaran tersebut. 8. Sekiranya Ahli Kad yang Layak mempunyai beberapa Kad Kredit/-i yang Layak, beliau dikehendaki mendaftar sekali sahaja dan selepas itu, amaun yang dicaj atas semua Kad Kredit/-i yang Layak yang lain akan secara automatik dikesan bagi tujuan pengiraan Urus niaga yang Layak. 9. Ahli Kad yang Layak bertanggungjawab untuk memastikan butiran pendaftaran adalah lengkap, tepat dan dihantar semasa Tempoh Kempen. Bukti penghantaran SMS bukanlah merupakan pengesahan penerimaan oleh Bank. 10. Ahli Kad yang Layak yang berjaya mendaftar untuk Kempen ini akan menerima pengakuan pendaftaran (diterima pakai untuk pendaftaran dalam talian sahaja) atau pengesahan SMS daripada Bank (diterima pakai untuk pendaftaran melalui SMS sahaja). Caj Pengendali Telekomunikasi biasa dikenakan bagi setiap pendaftaran SMS dan hendaklah dibayar sepenuhnya oleh Ahli Kad yang Layak. 10 11. Bank berhak atas budi bicara mutlaknya untuk tidak menerima apa-apa pendaftaran disebabkan oleh penyertaan berganda, tidak lengkap/tidak tepat, penyertaan lewat, mesej yang silap, pendaftaran yang tidak berjaya dibuat disebabkan oleh kegagalan rangkaian dan/atau gangguan yang dialami oleh Pengendali Telekomunikasi atau apa juga sebab yang Bank atas budi bicara mutlaknya anggap wajar. 12. Sekiranya SMS tidak lengkap/tidak sah, SMS balas akan dihantar kepada Ahli Kad yang Layak tanpa kos, memaklumkan kepada beliau untuk mendaftar semula melalui SMS. 13. Sekiranya tarikh dan waktu pendaftaran dalam talian melalui PBe/pendaftaran SMS yang berjaya dibuat atau tarikh dan waktu urus niaga yang dirakam dalam sistem Bank berbeza atau timbulnya pertikaian mengenai masa pendaftaran dibuat, tarikh dan waktu dalam sistem Bank akan diterima pakai. 14. Selepas pendaftaran dalam talian melalui PBe/pendaftaran SMS yang berjaya dibuat, Ahli Kad yang Layak perlu menggunakan Kad Kredit/-i yang Layak dengan cara yang berikut untuk layak mendapat ganjaran di bawah Kempen ini:Ganjaran Hadiah Pengaktifan Hadiah Alu-aluan Perkara Pulangan Tunai RM25 setiap Kad
Memohon Kad Kredit/-i yang Layak Pilihan 1 Set Bagasi Barry Smith 4 dalam 1 (“Barang Kempen”)

Aktifkan Kad Kredit/-i yang Layak dan membuat satu (1) urus niaga runcit bagi apa-apa amaun dalam tempoh 60 hari dari tarikh kad diluluskan (“Tempoh yang Layak”) untuk layak menerima Hadiah Pengaktifan Kata Kunci: PBMU 11 Kriteria Ganjaran Perkara Kriteria
Mendaftarkan penyertaan satu (1) kali dalam talian melalui PBe ATAU melalui Khidmat Pesanan Ringkas (SMS)* Pilihan 2 Pulangan Tunai RM300 (“Pulangan Tunai”)

Belanja urus niaga runcit terkumpul minimum sebanyak RM1,000 dalam tempoh 60 hari dari tarikh kad Kata Kunci: PBGM diluluskan (“Tempoh yang Layak”) untuk layak menerima SATU (1) unit Hadiah Alu-aluan *Pendaftaran dalam talian melalui PBe/pendaftaran SMS perlu dihantar dalam Tempoh yang Layak untuk layak menerima Hadiah Alu-aluan. 15. Pulangan Tunai RM25 setiap Kad (“Hadiah Pengaktifan”)
Ahli Kad yang Layak yang mengaktifkan Kad Kredit/-i yang Layak mereka DAN membuat satu (1) urus niaga runcit bagi apa-apa amaun dalam Tempoh yang Layak akan layak menerima Hadiah Pengaktifan.

Hadiah Pengaktifan akan dikreditkan dalam akaun Kad Kredit/-i yang Layak milik Ahli Kad yang Layak dalam tempoh EMPAT (4) hingga DUA BELAS (12) minggu selepas akhir Tempoh yang Layak dan apabila semua Terma dan Syarat yang disenaraikan dipenuhi.
Setiap Ahli Kad yang Layak layak menerima SATU (1) Hadiah Pengaktifan untuk setiap akaun Kad Kredit/-i yang Layak sepanjang Tempoh Kempen. 16. Hadiah Alu-aluan

Ahli Kad yang Layak yang berbelanja urus niaga runcit terkumpul minimum sebanyak RM1,000 DAN mendaftarkan penyertaannya satu kali dalam talian melalui PBe/SMS dalam Tempoh yang Layak akan layak untuk menerima Hadiah Alu-aluan.
Setiap Ahli Kad yang Layak hanya layak menerima SATU (1) unit Hadiah Alu-aluan sepanjang Tempoh Kempen tanpa mengira bilangan Kad Kredit/-i yang Layak yang dipohon. 12
Pemilihan Hadiah Aluan hendaklah dimuktamadkan berdasarkan Kata Kunci yang didaftarkan oleh Ahli Kad Yang Layak.

Pilihan 1: Set Bagasi Barry Smith 4 dalam 1 (“Barang Kempen”) 16.4.1. Barang Kempen akan diberikan berdasarkan siapa cepat, dia dapat, sementara stok masih ada. 16.4.2. Barang Kempen dan/atau warna Barang Kempen tertakluk pada terdapatnya stok. Sekiranya berlaku keadaan yang tidak dijangka, Public Bank berhak untuk menukarkannya dengan barang lain yang sama nilai atau lebih tinggi nilainya. 16.4.3. Barang Kempen tidak termasuk apa-apa aksesori dan barang yang ditunjukkan dalam apa-apa iklan dan/atau bahan promosi hanyalah untuk tujuan ilustrasi sahaja. 16.4.4. Barang Kempen akan dihantar ke alamat surat-menyurat Ahli Kad yang Layak di Malaysia dalam tempoh EMPAT (4) hingga DUA BELAS (12) minggu selepas akhir Tempoh yang Layak dan apabila semua Terma dan Syarat yang disenaraikan dipenuhi. 16.4.5. Bank tidak akan melayani apa-apa permintaan untuk menghantar Barang Kempen ke alamat di luar negeri, pihak ketiga dan/atau alamat Peti Surat Pejabat Pos. 16.4.6. Pemberian dan penghantaran Barang Kempen dikendalikan oleh JCMS ProRewards Sdn Bhd (No. Syarikat 556838-A) dengan alamat berdaftarnya di 19, Jalan 51/203A, Seksyen 51, Kawasan Perindustrian Tiong Nam, 46050 Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia. 16.4.7. Maklumat perhubungan dan penghantaran Ahli Kad yang Layak akan dikongsikan dengan JCMS ProRewards Sdn Bhd bagi tujuan pemberian dan penghantaran Barang Kempen. 16.4.8. JCMS ProRewards Sdn Bhd akan menghubungi Ahli Kad yang Layak untuk mengesahkan alamat bagi tujuan penghantaran Barang Kempen apabila perlu sahaja. Ahli Kad yang Layak 13 hendaklah menghubungi JCMS ProRewards Sdn Bhd melalui 037890 3616 atau 03-7890 3213 mengenai apa-apa pertanyaan berkenaan dengan penghantaran Barang Kempen. 16.4.9. Public Bank tidak menjamin atau bertanggungjawab atas apa-apa kerosakan atau kecederaan badan yang diakibatkan oleh penggunaan Barang Kempen dan tidak mewakili kualiti atau kesesuaian untuk menggunakan Barang Kempen bagi apa-apa tujuan.

Bank tidak membuat representasi atau jaminan berkaitan dengan kualiti, kebolehpasaran atau kesesuaian untuk menggunakan bagi Barang Kempen dan sewajarnya Bank tidak akan dipertanggungjawabkan untuk menggantikan apa-apa Barang Kempen yang hilang, dicuri atau rosak disebabkan kecacatan dari segi bahan atau mutu oleh pengeluar di bawah jaminan atau sebaliknya. Ahli Kad yang Layak hendaklah menghubungi pengeluar secara terus dan/atau peniaganya yang dibenarkan untuk mendapatkan maklumat jaminan, tuntutan dan/atau Terma dan Syarat khusus berkenaan pemasangan, spesifikasi, penggunaan, dan/atau pengendalian Barang Kempen.

Apa-apa risiko kehilangan atau kerosakan Barang Kempen akan ditanggung oleh Ahli Kad yang Layak selepas penghantaran Barang Kempen. Bank tidak bertanggungjawab untuk mengenal pasti atau menggantikan apa-apa kecacatan, kehilangan, kerosakan atau kecurian selepas penghantaran Barang Kempen.

Pilihan 2: Pulangan Tunai RM300 (“Pulangan Tunai”) 16.5.1. 17. Pulangan Tunai akan dikreditkan dalam akaun Kad Kredit/-i milik Ahli Kad yang Layak dalam tempoh EMPAT (4) hingga DUA BELAS (12) minggu selepas akhir Tempoh yang Layak dan apabila semua Terma dan Syarat yang disenaraikan dipenuhi. Hadiah Pengaktifan dan Hadiah Alu-aluan tidak boleh dipindah milik, tidak boleh dirundingi dan tidak boleh ditukar dengan hadiah lain, tunai, kredit atau barang. 14 18. Sekiranya terdapat pertikaian atau Hadiah Pengaktifan dan Hadiah Alu-aluan tidak diterima, Ahli Kad yang Layak perlu menghubungi Perkhidmatan Pelanggan Kad PB (03-2170 8000) sebelum 31 Mac 2027. Tiada pertanyaan akan dilayani selepas 31 Mac 2027. 19. Bagi tujuan Kempen ini, “urus niaga runcit” bermaksud pembelian apa-apa barang atau perkhidmatan (dalam dan luar negeri) menggunakan Kad Kredit/-i yang Layak dan boleh, atas budi bicara Public Bank, termasuk urus niaga Kad Kredit/-i yang Layak seperti yang akan ditentukan oleh Public Bank melainkan untuk urus niaga yang berikut tetapi tidak terhad pada: 20. a) Bayaran ansuran bulanan “Flexipay” dan “Pelan Ansuran Faedah Sifar/Pelan Ansuran Keuntungan Sifar” b) Pindahan Baki c) Bayaran Debit Auto dan Bayaran Berulang d) Bayaran untuk utiliti, pemasaran terus, premium insuran, pembayaran berkaitan kerajaan, pembayaran melalui www.pbebank.com, Aplikasi MyPB dan ATM e) Apa-apa pulangan balik, urus niaga yang dipertikaikan, tidak dibenarkan atau bagi tujuan penipuan f) Pendahuluan Tunai/Pengeluaran Tunai, separa tunai, urus niaga pertukaran wang asing, urus niaga kasino, pembayaran faedah, fi pembayaran lewat, caj kewangan/kadar keuntungan efektif, fi tahunan, penarikbalikan, pembayaran kepada badan-badan kebajikan dan apa-apa jenis fi perkhidmatan/rencam “Urus niaga runcit” hendaklah tidak termasuk urus niaga yang Bank mungkin anggap bukan urus niaga runcit, termasuk tetapi tidak terhad kepada urus niaga yang dibuat oleh Ahli Kad yang Layak bagi tujuan perniagaan, komersial atau penjualan semula, pembelian secara pukal serta urus niaga yang dibuat dengan mana-mana saudagar yang berkaitan atau dikawal oleh mereka (sama ada sebagai pekerja, majikan, pemegang saham atau pengarah) misalnya urus niaga oleh Ahli Kad yang Layak dengan mana-mana perbadanan atau entiti perniagaan yang beliau merupakan pekerja, majikan atau bekerja dengannya atau mempunyai saham atau kepentingan di dalamnya atau merupakan pengarah. 15 Tidak termasuk urus niaga yang Bank mungkin anggap sebagai tindakan atau amalan yang disengajakan untuk mengelirukan, menyembunyikan kebenaran atau menggunakan muslihat untuk memperoleh manfaat, melibatkan perlakuan tidak jujur, penipuan atau helah. 21. Ahli Kad yang Layak yang akaun kadnya telah digantung, dibatalkan atau ditamatkan semasa Tempoh Kempen tidak layak untuk Hadiah Pengaktifan dan Hadiah Alu-aluan. 22. Rekod Bank mengenai tarikh permohonan diterima dan kelulusan adalah muktamad dan konklusif. Terma dan Syarat Am 23. Bank berhak untuk menukar, meminda, memotong atau membuat penambahan kepada Terma dan Syarat dari semasa ke semasa dengan memberi notis awal sekurang-kurangnya dua puluh satu (21) hari kalendar mengenai perubahan, pindaan, potongan atau tambahan yang hendaklah diterbitkan dalam laman web rasmi Bank. 24. terms_clauses.text: Terms & Conditions “Spend More, Earn More & WIN BIG ANG POW with PB Visa Credit Card” Campaign PB Campaign for Credit Cardmembers Campaign Period
The “Spend More, Earn More & WIN BIG ANG POW with PB Visa Credit Card” Campaign is valid from 15 October 2026 to 28 February 2027 (the “Campaign Period”). Eligibility

This Campaign is open to all Public Bank (“PB”) and Public Islamic Bank (“PIB”) Principal Visa Credit Cardmembers (hereinafter referred to as “Eligible Cardmember”) during the Campaign Period. Top Spender Contest is not applicable to PB Visa Commercial Card, PB Visa Business Card, employees of the Public Bank Group, Public Bank subsidiaries, Public Bank’s advertising agencies and their immediate families. Participation Criteria

To participate in this Campaign, Eligible Cardmember is required to register his participation during the Campaign Period in the following manner:• Online registration via PBe using Key Word: PBV OR • SMS PBV and send to 68333 Any online/SMS registration with a Supplementary Credit Card mobile phone number shall not be accepted and shall be void. 4. Eligible Cardmember is required to register his participation using the mobile phone number that is registered with the Bank. In the event the mobile phone number or information provided by the credit cardmember during the registration process differs from the Bank’s system, the Bank reserves the absolute discretion to disqualify the said participation registration. 5. Eligible Cardmember with multiple credit cards is required to register only once and thereafter, the amounts charged on all other credit cards and the supplementary card(s) shall be automatically tracked for the purpose of tabulation of the Qualifying Retail Transactions. 6. The Eligible Cardmember is responsible to ensure that the online/SMS registration details are complete, accurate and sent during the Campaign Period. Proof of online/SMS registration sent does not constitute a confirmation of receipt by the Bank. 1 7. Eligible Cardmember who successfully registers for the Campaign will receive an acknowledgment of registration (applicable for online registration only) or a SMS confirmation from the Bank (applicable for registration via SMS only). The standard normal telecommunication operator charges apply for each SMS registration and shall be fully borne by the Eligible Cardmember. 8. In the event the SMS is incomplete/invalid, an outgoing SMS will be sent to the Eligible Cardmember, at no cost, to inform him to re-register via SMS. 9. The Bank will not be held responsible and reserves the absolute discretion to disqualify any registration from a supplementary cardmember, any duplicate entries, incomplete/inaccurate online/SMS registration, late entries, error messages, unsuccessful registration due to network failure and/or interruption experienced by a telecommunication operator or for any reason whatsoever as the Bank may in its absolute discretion deem fit.

If the date and time of a successful online/SMS registration or transaction date and time captured in the Bank’s system differs or a dispute arises as to when the registration took place, the Bank’s system date and time shall prevail. Campaign Mechanic

After the successful online/SMS registration, the Eligible Cardmember is required to use any of his credit cards in the following manner to qualify for this Campaign:A) Cash Back Campaign The Eligible Cardmember must spend his credit card for a minimum accumulative of RM2,000 in a month for Qualifying Retail Transactions in any one participating month during Campaign Period to qualify for the following Cash Back payment:Minimum Accumulative Local Spending in a Month Cash Back payment per Eligible Cardmember per month on a first-come, firstserved basis (RM) Maximum Cash Total Cash Back Back payment per Allocation per Eligible month on a Cardmember first-come, per month on a first-served first-come, firstbasis served basis (RM) (RM) RM2,000 + 5 Retail Transactions 48 19,200 RM5,000 + 10 Retail Transactions 118 35,400 RM9,000 + 15 Retail Transactions 218 43,600 218 2 B) Top Spender Contest The Eligible Cardmember must spend his credit card for a minimum accumulative of RM38,000 for Qualifying Retail Transactions in any one participating month during Campaign Period. The Top Spender with highest spending amount will be the winners to win for the following Prizes:Minimum Accumulative Local Spending in a Month RM38,000 Monthly Prize No of Winners in a Month No. of Winners throughout the Campaign Period 1 4 5 20 8 32 14 56 Grand Prize RM8,888 ANG POW 2nd Prize RM3,388 ANG POW 3rd Prize RM1,188 ANG POW Total

The Bank will pay a maximum Cash Back payment of RM98,200 each participating month during the Campaign Period. The Cash Back payment per month is as follows:Participating Months Month 1 Participating Months Dates 15 October - 30 November 2026 Monthly Cash Back Allocation (RM) 98,200 Month 2 1 December - 31 December 2026 98,200 Month 3 1 January - 31 January 2027 98,200 Month 4 1 February - 28 February 2027 98,200 Total 392,800

The maximum Cash Back payment will not exceed RM218 each participating month per Eligible Cardmember on a first-come, first-served basis. 3 Note:(1) “Qualified Retail Transactions” shall include all local retail spending, online purchases and new Zero Interest/Profit Instalment Plan (ZIIP/ZPIP) full purchase amount (not monthly instalment), e-wallet top up and excludes flexipay instalment amount, balance transfer, auto-debit, recurring payments, payments for utilities, direct marketing, insurance premium, government related payments, payment via www.pbebank.com, MyPB App, ATM, any refund, disputed, unauthorized or fraudulent retail transactions, cash advance/cash withdrawal, quasi cash, casino transaction, interest payments, late payment fees, finance charges, effective profit rate, annual fees, reversals, payment to charity(ies) and any form of service/miscellaneous fees.

“Qualified Retail Transactions” shall exclude transactions that the Bank may deem as non-qualified retail transactions, including but not limited to transactions made by the Cardmember for business, commercial or resale purposes, purchases made in bulk and transactions made with any merchant associated or controlled by them (whether as an employee, employer, shareholder or director) e.g. transactions by Cardmember with any corporation or business entity in which he is an employee or employer or works with or has shares or interest in or is a director of. Exclude transactions that the Bank may deem as act or practice of deliberately misleading, hiding truth, or using artifice to gain advantage, involves dishonest behaviour, fraud, or tricks.

Qualified Retail Transactions made by a Supplementary Cardmember(s) shall be aggregated with the Eligible Cardmember’s and the total eligible Cash Back payment/Prizes will only be credited/awarded into the Eligible Cardmember’s credit card account.

The Cash Back payment/Prizes earned by the Eligible Cardmember shall be tracked in the following manner:Online/SMS Registration Received in a Month M1 M2 M3 M4 Note: M = Month M1 Qualifying Retail Transaction in each Tracking Month M2 M3 - ✓ ✓ - - ✓ ✓ ✓ - - - ✓ M4 ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ For example, A Eligible Cardmember successfully registered via online/SMS on Month 1 of the Campaign Period will have his Qualifying Retail Transactions being tracked for the Month 1, and thereafter till the end of the Campaign Period.
The tracking of Qualified Retail Transactions shall be based on transaction dates. 4

Split Qualified Retail Transactions up to EIGHT (8) times only per month from the same merchant are allowed to qualify for this campaign. As such, transactions above 8 times, shall be disqualified from the campaign.
Each Eligible Cardmember is entitled to win ONE (1) Monthly Prize throughout the Campaign Period.

terms_clauses.text: Electrify Your Cash Back with PB Visa Credit Card Terms and Conditions Campaign Period 1. The Campaign is valid from 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2027 (“Campaign Period”). Eligibility 2. This Campaign is open to all Public Bank Berhad (“PB”) and Public Islamic Bank Berhad (“PIB”) Principal Visa Credit Cardmembers, employees of the Public Bank Group, PB subsidiaries, PB’s advertising agencies and their immediate families (hereinafter referred to as “Eligible Cardmember”) during the Campaign Period. 3. All Public Bank Debit Cardmembers are not entitled to participate in this Campaign. 4. To participate in this Campaign, Eligible Cardmember is required to register participation during the Campaign Period as per registration process set out below: a) Online registration via PBe using Campaign Key Word: PBM OR b) SMS PBM and send to 68333 Any online/SMS registration with a Supplementary Credit Card mobile phone number shall not be accepted and shall be void. 5. Eligible Cardmember is required to register his participation using the mobile phone number that is registered with the Bank. In the event the mobile phone number or information provided by the credit cardmember during the registration process differs from the Bank’s system, the Bank reserves the absolute discretion to disqualify the said participation registration. 6. Eligible Cardmember with multiple credit cards is required to register only once and thereafter, the amounts charged on all other credit cards and the supplementary card(s) shall be automatically tracked for the purpose of tabulation of the Qualifying Retail Transactions. 7. Eligible Cardmember is responsible to ensure that the online/SMS registration details are complete, accurate and sent during the Campaign Period. Proof of online/SMS registration sent does not constitute a confirmation of receipt by the Bank. Page 1 of 12 8. Eligible Cardmember who successfully registers for the Campaign will receive an acknowledgment of registration (applicable for online registration only) or a SMS confirmation from the Bank (applicable for registration via SMS only). The standard normal telecommunication operator charges apply for each SMS registration and shall be fully borne by the Eligible Cardmember. 9. In the event the SMS is incomplete/invalid, an outgoing SMS will be sent to the Eligible Cardmember, at no cost, to inform him/her to re-register via SMS. 10. The Bank will not be held responsible and reserves the absolute discretion to disqualify any registration from a supplementary cardmember, any duplicate entries, incomplete/inaccurate online/SMS registration, late entries, error messages, unsuccessful registration due to network failure and/or interruption experienced by a telecommunication operator or for any reason whatsoever as the Bank may in its absolute discretion deem fit. 11. If the date and time of a successful online/SMS registration or transaction date and time captured in the Bank’s system differs or a dispute arises as to when the registration took place, the Bank’s system date and time shall prevail. Campaign Mechanic 12. The 25% Cash Back to be rewarded is based on EV (Electric Vehicle) Charging Transactions with minimum accumulated spend of RM1,000 on Retail Transactions monthly: Minimum accumulated spend on retail transactions monthly RM1,000 Cash Back on EV Charging Transactions (Merchant Category Codes (MCC): 5552 and 7523) 25% Maximum Cash Back payment per Cardmember per month during the Campaign Period on first-come, first-served basis RM50 Each Eligible Cardmember is entitled to a maximum Monthly Cash Back of RM50 per Participating Month and RM600 throughout the Campaign Period, subject to the Monthly Cash Back allocation on a first-come, first-served basis. Definitions “EV Charging Transactions” shall include all transactions on MCC 5552 and 7523. “Qualifying Retail Transactions” shall include all retail spending, online purchases and new Zero Interest/Profit Instalment Plan (ZIIP/ZPIP) full purchase amount (not monthly instalment), e-wallet top up and excludes Page 2 of 12 flexipay instalment amount, balance transfer, auto-debit, recurring payments, payments for utilities, direct marketing, insurance premium, government related payments, payment via www.pbebank.com, MyPB app, ATM, any refund, disputed, unauthorized or fraudulent retail transactions, cash advance/cash withdrawal, quasi cash, casino transaction, interest payments, late payment fees, finance charges, effective profit rate, annual fees, reversals, payment to charity(ies) and any form of service/miscellaneous fees. “Qualifying Retail Transactions” shall exclude transactions that the Bank may deem as non-retail transactions, including but not limited to transactions made by the Cardmember for business, commercial or resale purposes, purchases made in bulk and transactions made with any merchant associated or controlled by them (whether as an employee, employer, shareholder or director) e.g. transactions by Cardmember with any corporation or business entity in which he is an employee or employer or works with or has shares or interest in or is a director of. Exclude transactions that the Bank may deem as act or practice of deliberately misleading, hiding truth, or using artifice to gain advantage, involves dishonest behaviour, fraud, or tricks. “EV Charging Transactions” and “Qualifying Retail Transactions” made by a Supplementary Cardmember(s) shall be aggregated with the Principal Cardmember’s and will be considered as Principal Cardmember’s Qualified Spend and the total eligible Cash Back payment/Prizes will only be credited/awarded into the Eligible Cardmember’s credit card account. Split “Qualifying Retail Transactions” up to EIGHT (8) times only per month from the same merchant are allowed to qualify for this campaign. As such, transactions above 8 times, shall be disqualified from the campaign. Mekanisme Kempen 3.1 Takrifan:a) “DuitNow Pay-to-Proxy” (Bayar kepada Proksi) merujuk kepada urus niaga kepada penerima lain melalui DuitNow ID. b) “DuitNow ID” merujuk kepada pengenalan unik penerima seperti nombor telefon mudah alih atau nombor kad pengenalan pendaftaran kebangsaan yang telah didaftarkan dan dirangkaikan kepada akaun penerima. c) “DuitNow QR Peer-to-Peer” (P2P) (Pengguna kepada Pengguna) merujuk kepada perkhidmatan pindahan dana elektronik yang memudahkan pindahan kredit yang disalurkan menggunakan maklumat yang diperoleh dengan mengimbas Kod QR yang mematuhi Piawaian Kod DuitNow QR Kebangsaaan kepada penerima lain. d) “Piawaian Kod DuitNow QR Kebangsaan” merujuk kepada spesifikasi Piawaian Kod Respons Segera DuitNow Kebangsaan yang dibangunkan dan diuruskan oleh Pemilik dan Pengendali DuitNow QR. e) “Kod QR” merujuk kepada kod bar dua dimensi yang boleh dibaca menggunakan kamera telefon pintar atau peranti mudah alih yang dilengkapi dengan pembaca QR. f) “Pemilik dan Pengendali DuitNow QR” merujuk kepada Payments Network Malaysia Sdn Bhd (No. Pendaftaran 200801035403 (836743-D)). g) “Kumpulan Public Bank” merujuk kepada PBB, subsidiari dan syarikat yang berkaitan dengannya. h) “Instagram” merujuk kepada platform media sosial yang dikendalikan oleh Meta Platforms, Inc. dan/atau ahli gabungannya. i) “Akaun Instagram” merujuk kepada akaun yang didaftarkan pada platform Instagram dan dikenal pasti melalui nama pengguna Instagram yang unik. Bagi tujuan Kempen ini, nama pengguna Akaun Instagram Pelanggan yang Layak mestilah sama atau dapat dikenal pasti dengan nama Pelanggan yang Layak. j) “Umum” merujuk kepada tetapan privasi bagi Akaun Instagram yang membenarkan akaun dan kandungannya dilihat oleh warga umum tanpa memerlukan kelulusan atau kebenaran daripada pemegang akaun. k) “Hantaran Instagram” merujuk kepada hantaran yang dimuat naik oleh Pelanggan yang Layak pada Akaun Instagram beliau semasa Tempoh Kempen yang memenuhi semua syarat-syarat yang ditetapkan di bawah Syarat Kelayakan, termasuk penggunaan Tanda Pagar Kempen (#DeepavaliwithMyPBApp). l) “Ikuti” merujuk kepada tindakan Pelanggan yang Layak menggunakan Akaun Instagram beliau untuk mengikuti Akaun Instagram rasmi Bank, @publicbankmy. m) “Suka” merujuk kepada bilangan suka yang diterima oleh Pelanggan yang Layak pada Hantaran Instagram beliau, yang akan digunakan untuk menentukan pemenang. n) “Tag” merujuk kepada tindakan menyebut akaun Instagram rasmi Public Bank Malaysia @publicbankmy, dalam Hantaran Instagram. terms_clauses.text: KEMPEN “Travel with MyPB App!” TERMA DAN SYARAT Kempen “Travel with MyPB App!” (“Kempen”) dilancarkan oleh Public Bank Berhad (No. Pendaftaran Syarikat 196501000672 (6463-H)) (“PBB”). Terma dan Syarat di bawah (“Terma dan Syarat”) mengawal Kempen ini.
Kempen 1.1 Kempen ini akan bermula dari 1 Oktober 2026 hingga 31 Disember 2026, termasuk kedua-dua tarikh atau tarikh lain seperti yang ditentukan oleh PBB dari semasa ke semasa (“Tempoh Kempen”).

Kelayakan Kempen 2.1 Kempen ini terbuka kepada semua pelanggan individu baharu dan sedia ada PBB dan Public Islamic Bank Berhad (No. Pendaftaran Syarikat 197301001433 (14328-V)) (“PIBB”) (secara kolektif dirujuk sebagai “Bank”) berumur 18 tahun dan ke atas yang mempunyai akses kepada Bank MyPB mudah alih (“MyPB App”) dan menyenggara mana-mana akaun yang berikut (“Pelanggan yang Layak”):Akaun Semasa/Akaun Simpanan Konvensional (“CASA”) Akaun Semasa-i/Akaun Simpanan-i Murabahan Komoditi (“CMCA-i / CMSA-i”)  Akaun Simpanan Basic  Akaun Simpanan-i Murabahah Komoditi  Akaun Simpanan PLUS  Akaun Simpanan-i ForU2Save Murabahah Komoditi  Akaun Simpanan-i PB MySalary Murabahah Komoditi  Akaun PLUS  Akaun Simpanan MoneyPLUS  Akaun Simpanan PB MySalary  Akaun Simpanan-i BASIC Murabahah Komoditi Akaun Simpanan PB UnionPay  Akaun Semasa-i Murabahah Komoditi  Simpanan 50  Akaun Semasa PLUS  Akaun Semasa Basic  Akaun Premier ACE  Akaun ACE  Akaun Semasa-i PLUS Murabahah Komoditi  Akaun Semasa-i BASIC Murabahah Komoditi 2.2 Untuk akaun bersama, Pelanggan yang Layak merupakan pemegang akaun yang namanya pertama dalam akaun bersama seperti yang dinyatakan dalam rekod PBB atau PIBB, mengikut mana-mana yang berkenaan. 2.3 Mereka yang berikut tidak layak untuk mengambil bahagian dalam Kempen ini: a) pelanggan yang akaunnya telah ditutup, ditamatkan atau digantung sebelum apa-apa hadiah diberikan; b) pelanggan yang akaunnya dipegang dengan PBB dan/atau PIBB culas atau tidak disenggara dengan memuaskan seperti yang ditetapkan oleh PBB dan/atau PIBB; c) pelanggan yang tidak waras; d) pelanggan yang diisytiharkan bankrap atau mempunyai prosiding guaman dalam apa juga bentuk terhadap mereka; dan e) pelanggan bukan individu iaitu keempunyaan tunggal, perkongsian, entiti korporat, persatuan, kelab, sekolah dan pertubuhan.

Mekanisme Kempen 3.1 Takrifan: a) “Perkhidmatan Alipay+” merujuk kepada perkhidmatan yang dijalankan melalui Alipay+ Core dan disediakan oleh Pengendali Alipay+ Core yang membolehkan anda membuat bayaran atau memindahkan dana kepada Saudagar melalui Kaedah Bayaran Mod Dikemukakan Saudagar atau Kaedah Bayaran Mod Dikemukakan Pengguna. b) “Alipay+ Core” merujuk kepada sistem yang digunakan oleh Pengendali Alipay+ Core dan ahli gabungannya untuk menjalankan pemprosesan, pengesahan dan penyelesaian bayaran elektronik serta menyediakan bayaran digital melalui pertukaran maklumat dan bayaran digital rentas sempadan. 3.2 c) “Pengendali Alipay+ Core” merujuk kepada Alipay Connect Pte. Ltd. dan semua ahli gabungannya yang mengendalikan Alipay+ Core, termasuk pengganti dan penerima serah hak yang berperanan sebagai rangkaian bayaran dan penyedia infrastruktur berpusat yang dikongsi. d) “Saudagar” merujuk kepada perniagaan, keempunyaan tunggal, perkongsian, badan berkanun, pertubuhan dan/atau entiti lain yang sama yang menerima bayaran melalui Perkhidmatan Alipay+. e) “Bayaran Mod Dikemukakan Saudagar” merujuk kepada kaedah bayaran QR yang mana Saudagar mempamerkan Kod QR untuk diimbas oleh pengguna atau pelanggan. f) “Bayaran Mod Dikemukakan Pengguna” merujuk kepada kaedah bayaran QR yang mana pengguna atau pelanggan menunjukkan Kod QR untuk diimbas oleh Saudagar. g) “Kumpulan Public Bank” merujuk kepada PBB, subsidiari dan syarikat yang berkaitan dengannya. h) “Instagram” merujuk kepada platform media sosial yang dikendalikan oleh Meta Platforms, Inc. dan/atau ahli gabungannya. i) “Akaun Instagram” merujuk kepada akaun yang didaftarkan dan disenggara oleh Pelanggan yang Layak di Instagram. terms_clauses.text: ONLINE PROMOTION Last update: 1 Jul 2026 PROMOTION PERIOD The Hong Leong Bank Berhad [Company No. 193401000023 (97141-X)] (“HLB”) and MSIG Insurance (Malaysia) Bhd [Company No. 197901002705 (46983-W)] (“MSIG”) jointly organised Online Promotion (“Promotion”) commences on 1 July 2026 and ends on 31 December 2026 both dates inclusive (“Promotion Period”), unless otherwise notified. This Promotion, is open to all HLB customers including Malaysian and non-Malaysian individuals (“Eligible Customers”). 2. Eligible Customers who have committed or who HLB has reasonable ground(s) to believe have committed any fraudulent or wrongful acts in relation to any products and/or any of the facilities granted by HLB/Hong Leong Islamic Bank Berhad (“HLISB”) [Company No. 200501009144 (686191W)] or have been declared bankrupt (pursuant to a petition by either HLB/HLISB or any third party) or are subject to any bankruptcy proceedings at any time prior to or during the Promotion Period shall NOT be eligible to participate in the Promotion. 3. HLB credit card accounts of such HLB Cardholders (“Credit Card Accounts”) are not in default and are in good standing;

HLB Cardholders who have not committed or who HLB does not have reasonable grounds to believe have committed any fraudulent, unlawful or wrongful acts in relation to any of the facilities granted by HLB/HLISB;
HLB Cardholders who have not been declared bankrupt (pursuant to a petition by any banks or any third party) or are subject to any bankruptcy proceedings; or

HLB Cardholders who have not committed or are not believed by HLB/HLISB, with reasonable grounds, to have committed any of the wrongful acts stipulated herein. 4. For the purpose of this Promotion, the eligible insurance products by MSIG are as follows (hereinafter referred to as “Eligible Insurance Product” or, in plural, “Eligible Insurance Products”): (a) Private Car Comprehensive Insurance; (b) Flexi Protector Personal Accident Insurance; (c) Critical Illness Plan; (d) Flexi Home Guard; (e) TravelRight Plus Insurance; and (f) Safe Deposit Locker Insurance. 1 PROMOTION MECHANICS 5. Under this Promotion, Eligible Cardholders who apply for any of the Eligible Insurance Products listed in Clause 4 (a) to (f) above will be entitled to apply for the Hong Leong 0% Extended Payment Plan (“EPP”) to facilitate payment of premium for the relevant Eligible Insurance Product by monthly instalments. 6. The Eligible Cardholders have the option to select the EPP of either 6 or 12 months tenure offered by MSIG whereby the interest rate is zero per cent (0%) subject to Clauses 7 and 8 below. 7. The Eligible Cardholders are allowed to apply up to a maximum of ninety per cent (90%) of the Eligible Cardholder’s combined credit limit for EPP transactions, regardless of the number of HLB credit cards held. The combined credit limit refers to the total credit limit common to and shared by all the HLB credit cards issued to each Eligible Cardholder excluding the temporary increase in the credit limit amount, if any. 8. The Eligible Cardholders must pay the monthly instalment specified in full which, for the first instalment, shall be at the time of EPP enrolment and for subsequent monthly instalments, shall be as indicated in the Eligible Cardholder’s monthly credit card statement (“EPP Monthly Instalment”). 9. The EPP Monthly Instalment is required to be paid in full together with all other items comprising the Minimum Payment Due (as defined in the Cardholder Agreement) such as the minimum five per cent (5%) of the total outstanding amount of the credit card, on or before the payment due date as specified in the monthly credit card statement. If Eligible Cardholders fail to settle the EPP Monthly Instalment in full, the balance of the EPP Monthly Instalment which remains unpaid shall be added to the credit card outstanding balance. All outstanding balance in the Credit Card Accounts shall be subject to Finance Charges and/or Late Payment Charges (if applicable), as defined in and in accordance with the Cardholder Agreement. 10. If the Eligible Cardholder fails or omits to pay the Minimum Payment Due (as defined in the Cardholder Agreement) two (2) times consecutively or if at any time the Credit Card Account(s) are suspended or terminated, the 0% EPP interest rate offer shall be withdrawn and the prevailing retail interest rate shall apply and the total outstanding unbilled amount of the EPP shall become due and immediately payable and billed to the relevant Credit Card Account. 11. HLB will not be concerned with any dispute between the Eligible Cardholders and MSIG. Notwithstanding the dispute between Eligible Cardholders and MSIG, Eligible Cardholders shall continue to pay the EPP Monthly Instalment due as per the statement to the Cardholders’ Credit Card Account. GENERAL 12. By participating in this Promotion, Eligible Customers: (a) confirm that they have read, understood and agreed to be bound by the T&Cs of the Promotion, the respective terms and conditions of the Eligible Insurance Products and any other relevant terms and conditions that HLB and MSIG may impose from time to time with prior notice by posting on HLB’s website at www.hlb.com.my (“HLB’s Website”); (b) agree that all records of transactions within or outside Malaysia captured by MSIG’s system(s) for the Promotion are final; 2 (c) (d) (e) (f) agree to access HLB’s Website and MSIG’s website at https://www.msig.com.my/ (“MSIG’s Website”) at regular time intervals to view the T&Cs and to ensure to be kept up-to-date on any changes or variations to the T&Cs and/or details of the Eligible Insurance Products; agree that HLB’s and/or MSIG’s decision on all matters relating to the Promotion shall be final, conclusive and binding on all Eligible Customers; authorise and consent for HLB and/or MSIG to disclose their personal data i.e., name, contact number and email address to an authorised third (3rd) party vendor (i.e. courier services) appointed by HLB and/or MSIG for the purpose of delivering the hardcopy insurance policy (if required) signed up in respect of the Eligible Insurance Products of this Promotion to the Eligible Customers; and agree that they have read, understood and agree to be bound by HLB’s Privacy Notice, which is available at HLB’s Website. 13. HLB reserves the right to add, delete, suspend or vary the T&Cs contained herein, wholly or in part, by giving twenty-one (21) days’ prior notice by way of posting on HLB’s Website or in any manner deemed practical by HLB. 14. The T&Cs herein shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Malaysia and Eligible Customers agree to submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Courts of Malaysia. 18. Words denoting one gender include all other genders and words denoting the singular include the plural and vice versa. 3 INSURANCE DISCLAIMER This document is not intended to be an invitation or offer for subscription of insurance nor does it amount to solicitation by HLB for subscription of insurance by anyone. Eligible Customers are advised to read and understand the contents of the Eligible Insurance Products brochure/policy contract before signing up.
